points.point: Why the post went out at 4:00 am New York time instead of 9:00 (time shift in scheduledTime)
Customer is in New York and scheduledTime has no timezone offset

verdict.reason: No candidate explains how scheduledTime without a timezone offset is interpreted or why a 9:00 time would publish at 4:00 am New York time; the closest entries cover publish-now behavior, free slots, rescheduling, or failed posts, which are neighboring questions.
